nodes.prompt: The season ends with ₹12,000 profit. A new phone costs ₹8,000. Your emergency fund is ₹0. What do you do?
nodes.voicePrompt: मौसम में ₹12,000 का मुनाफ़ा हुआ। नया फोन ₹8,000 का है। आपातकालीन फंड ₹0 है। क्या करेंगे?

nodes.prompt: Next season your child needed medicine costing ₹5,000. With only ₹4,000 left, you had to borrow.
nodes.lesson: An emergency fund of 3-6 months of expenses prevents taking loans during crises. Save before you spend.

nodes.prompt: Next season your child needed medicine. Your emergency fund covered it. No debt needed!
nodes.lesson: A healthy emergency fund (₹10,000-₹50,000) is the single most powerful financial protection for farming families.

nodes.prompt: Good balance! Your savings covered 80% of the emergency. Only a small loan was needed.
nodes.lesson: Balancing savings and family needs is wise. Even partial savings significantly reduce crisis impact.
